name: avatars
description: Claude speaks a short version of each reply through ElevenLabs, as a narrator or a cast of characters with animated portraits above the prompt

api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
api_key.description: Your own key from elevenlabs.io (Developers, API keys). Needs text-to-speech and voices read access. ELEVENLABS_API_KEY works too.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Who speaks in new sessions. Your own modes in ~/.claude/avatars/modes work here too.

speak.title: Speak replies
speak.description: Speak each reply in interactive sessions.

model.title: Voice model
model.description: The ElevenLabs model. v3/v4 models perform [audio tags].

voice.title: Narrator voice
voice.description: An ElevenLabs voice id for single-voice modes. Empty uses the mode's own.

ffmpeg.title: ffmpeg path
ffmpeg.description: Leave empty to use ffmpeg from PATH.
